contexts.text: This was the reason why the Lord did not come into the world until the Jewish Church acknowledged and believed nothing.
They came into the Land of Canaan () = that He arrived at the celestial things of love.
To come to his fathers () = to pass from the life of the body into the life of the spirit.
God came () = perception; for perception is nothing but the Divine coming or influx into the intellectual faculty.
To come to days () = when the state was at hand.
He came to Rachel () = conjunction with the affection of internal truth. To come to = to be conjoined.
To come to any woman, or to enter, when what is matrimonial is meant, = conjunction. AC 3918. AC 4870.
To come to meet = to flow in.
To come from the field () = consultation from their religion.
He cannot come into Heaven...
Jacob came to Isaac his father () = the Divine Rational with which it was conjoined... The conjunction is signified by his coming to him.
As Joseph came to his brethren () = when it had been predicated of Him... When this is said to come to them, it denotes that it is predicated to them.
To come, here, () = to will, for he who comes with a purpose, wills.
He came to Pharaoh () = communication with the new Natural. To come = communication, here, through influx.
Lo, seven years come () = a state of Providence. To come = what is of Providence...
To come to see () = to desire to know that it is so. AC 5439.
They came () = what is successive of reformation.
Joseph came home () = the presence of the internal.
Joseph's brethren have come () = the presence of the truths of the Church in the Natural. To have come = presence.
To come () = to approach.
They have caused to come () = to be present.
To come to anyone = presence. AC 6089. AC 6224. AC 8939. AC 9329.
To come to sojourn () = to seek life.
To cause to come () = to refer to, and introduce.
All Egypt came to Joseph () = application to the internal. To come to him = to be applied.
The sons of Israel coming into Egypt () = truths initiated into scientifics. AC 6639.
They came to Reuel their father () = conjunction with the good itself of the Church. To come to anyone = to be conjoined. AC 6783. AC 8657.
To come to speak () = to bring a command.
When such are newly come into the other life...
Come to Pharaoh () = the appearance of truth from the Divine with those who infest... To come, or enter into anyone, = presence or appearance. Explained.
To come, or enter in through the midst, () = to pass across.
They will come after them () = the effort to do violence through the influx of falsity from evil. AC 8209. AC 8231.
To come () = a stage of what is successive.
The people coming to Moses to inquire of God () = to consult as to what the Divine dictates. AC 8694.
To come to them () = to lead into good. See AC 10153:end.
They come to the Lord when they acknowledge Him as their God.
To come, when predicated of the Lord as to the Word, = enlightenment, for when the Lord comes, or is present in the Word, there is enlightenment.
Then the Lord came into the world...
To come, and go away () = the state of a thing from beginning to end.
Hence, when anyone is raised into any Society of Heaven, it is said that he comes into Heaven.
To come into Heaven is not merely to be raised among the Angels...
Things to come they know not...
He who is, Who was, and Who is to come () = the Lord, Who is infinite and eternal, and Jehovah. AE 23. AE 42.
He cometh with the clouds of heaven () = that the Lord will reveal Himself in the sense of the letter of the Word. AE 36.
To come quickly () = after this.
Come () = a calling.
Hence it is evident that unless the Lord had come into the world at that time... the communication of Heaven with men would have been broken, and mankind must have perished.
Until I come () = visitation.
Come and see = attention and perception. To come, when anything is presented to view, = to attend, for in the spiritual sense to come means to approach with the sight, thus to attend.
To come to the Lord () = to do His commandments.
After death, everyone comes to his like. Signified.
